annotation.authors_or_issuer: University of Guyana, Office of the Vice-Chancellor / Tactical Online Services Unit
annotation.summary_en: University of Guyana's 2023 internal policy on generative AI use in teaching, learning and assessment. It requires disclosure and citation of AI use, sets differentiated grading rubrics and penalties, ensures equitable access including for students with disabilities, and creates an AI working group and training. It has no embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Students must fully disclose and cite AI tool use, including prompts and tool version.
Separate grading rubrics and penalties apply to AI-assisted work; zero marks for undisclosed AI use.
Students with special education needs or disabilities must be allowed to use assistive AI tools.
An AI Working Group is established; policy reviewed every six months.
AI detection tools such as Turnitin are used with caution because of false positives.
